items.html: And behold, if in the morning there were only the Shema of the sacrifices alone, its coupling would be inferior, like the coupling of the evening. Therefore another time of the Shema of Yotzer was needed, in order to make another, more excellent coupling, and to draw a more excellent drawing, namely from the externality of Atik; and then all the Mochin of Gadlut, inner and encircling, of Aba and Ima, will enter into ZA.
